## Executive Summary
Semmozhiyan NS is a Site Reliability Engineer and the Founder & CEO of EKSISAI. He works on software systems, infrastructure, automation, and digital products, with experience across full-stack development, backend engineering, deployment workflows, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. EKSISAI is an independently operated technology solutions and software products brand founded and operated by Semmozhiyan NS; it is currently operated by him as an individual.

## Current Professional Role: NexGenAds Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
**Title**: Site Reliability Engineer (current role in 2026)
- Supports the reliability and operational stability of web applications and backend services.
- Works with deployment pipelines, infrastructure configuration, and application environments.
- Monitors application health, investigates issues, and troubleshoots service failures.
- Collaborates with development teams on deployment consistency and production readiness.
- Contributes to performance optimization and operational improvements.
